purpose: Test whether raw observations can predict when the fixed restorer helps, with an explicit preserve-input action.

first_isolated_experiment.teacher_mode: K1/current-only; fixed weights and0restorer optimizer updates
first_isolated_experiment.model_input: current and available past raw observations only; no clean targets/degradation ground truth/source-id
first_isolated_experiment.label: signed16x16tile error benefit MAE(input,target)-MAE(frozenK1,target), train sources only
first_isolated_experiment.head_candidate: reuse small observation-only feature extractor with one signed-benefit output; do not simultaneously redesign restorer or history gate
first_isolated_experiment.output: raw input or fixed K1 correction selected by predicted benefit at fixedzero threshold; ties preserve input; specify spatial boundary treatment before launch
controls: same head/capacity/budget with source-and-group-isolated shuffled whole-map benefit labels
first_isolated_experiment.training_and_data_budgets: Must freeze exact train-only label rows, source/condition-preserving shuffle and actual NPU/CPU/caching budget before executing. Existing dev oracle labels never used for training.
metrics: stride1 full-frame flow-aware temporal quality later; tiled crop scores alone insufficient

decision_before_combining_history: Confirm raw-only benefit prediction beats shuffled head and fixedK1 at matched budget.
Report protection/fidelity tradeoff without picking dev thresholds/checkpoints; no bypass-all trivial solution accepted as restoration progress.
Retain failed outcomes; no extra teacher steps or automatic scale-up.
Define fresh source-disjoint test independent of the6dev sources used in this design.
further_history_experiment: After input-preservation test, evaluate predicted two-slot LOO/history decision with same bypass and comparable cost; four-state routing is secondary only if observed residual interaction justifies it.
